name: Sumeragi Tenma
source:
Leader of the Summer Troupe.

"A talented actor who was a prodigy child actor, he is a thoroughbred whose parents are both movie stars. He has absolute confidence in his own acting, has an "oresama" personality, and hates to lose. It's because of that that he doesn't have many friends. Although he was in the middle of filming for a movie, he joined the MANKAI Company for a certain reason to take on the stage."

[From the [url=https://yaycupcake.com/a3/index.php?title=Tenma_Sumeragi]A3! Wiki[/url]]
